title: Shaded Beige Retractable Wall Hook, 2-1/2-Inch Pull-Out, Wall-Mounted Brass - Carolina (Patent Pending), Allied Brass
description: Retractable wall hook (patent pending) with 2-1/2 inches / 2-1/2-inch / 2.5" pull-out hanging space for bathroom towels, robes, and coats — available in Shaded Beige, which offers sophisticated warmth in a soft, neutral tone that complements natural materials and earthy palettes. This wall mount / wall-mounted hook uses brass construction and a space-saving retractable rod that pulls out for use and pushes back in when not needed. Installs in standard interior walls with included toggle bolts (6/32 toggles); installation requires drilling a 3/4" dia. hole through drywall plus three small holes around. Holds up to 15 lb. Includes a removable knob tip so you can replace it with a cabinet knob to match existing hardware. Overall dimensions: 1.75 in L x 1.75 in H x 3.75 in W; 1 in projection. Backed by a lifetime warranty. Part of the Carolina collection for matching Carolina traditional bathroom hardware and classic bath accessories. Allied Brass.
